description: This file defines a Flutter widget for a credit/debit card payment page, including UI components for entering card details, displaying a stylized card, and navigating to a payment success page.

classes.name: CreditCardPage
classes.description: A StatelessWidget representing the credit/debit card payment interface with input fields and a stylized card display.

methods.name: bodyData
methods.description: Builds the main scrollable content of the page, including header, card display, and input fields.

methods.name: creditCardWidget
methods.description: Creates a visual representation of the credit card with background, logo, and name.

methods.name: cardEntries
methods.description: Displays current card details such as number, expiry, and CVV using StreamBuilder.

methods.name: fillEntries
methods.description: Provides input fields for card number, expiry date, CVV, and name on card.

methods.name: floatingBar
methods.description: Creates a floating action button that navigates to the payment success page.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the Scaffold containing the entire page layout.
